```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Filter to patients of interest
patients_of_interest <- c("Patient12", "Patient17", "Patient20_425", "Patient20_519")

spe_sub <- spe_combined[, spe_combined$patient_id %in% patients_of_interest]

# Facet by sample_id (ROI) within each patient
plotReducedDim(spe_sub,
               dimred = "UMAP_harmony",
               colour_by = "sample_id",
               point_size = 0.3,
               point_alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ spe_sub$patient_id, ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "UMAP After Harmony - Patients with Isolated Clusters",
       subtitle = "Colored by ROI, faceted by patient") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
patient_colors <- c(
  "Patient12"     = "cornflowerblue",
  "Patient17"     = "gold",
  "Patient20_425" = "forestgreen",
  "Patient20_519" = "coral"
)


for(patient in patients_of_interest) {
  spe_patient <- spe_combined[, spe_combined$patient_id == patient]
  
  p <- plotReducedDim(spe_patient,
                      dimred = "UMAP_harmony",
                      colour_by = "patient_id",
                      point_size = 0.5,
                      point_alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ spe_patient$sample_id) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = patient_colors) +
    labs(title = paste("UMAP After Harmony -", patient),
         subtitle = "Faceted by ROI") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  print(p)
}
```
# Check for Harmony overcorrection
```{r}
library(viridis)

markers_to_check <- c("EpCAM", "SMA", "CD68", "CD8a", "CD19", "FoxP3", "LAMP3")

for(marker in markers_to_check){
  umap_coords <- reducedDim(spe_combined, "UMAP_harmony")
  expr <- assay(spe_combined, "counts")[marker, ]
  
  df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2],
    expr  = expr
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = expr)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
    labs(title = paste("UMAP_harmony colored by", marker),
         color = marker) +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(p)
}

```
Expression of markers is localized to specific regions of the UMAP. CD19 looks a bit more spread out than the other markers.

# Check with more markers
```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
library(patchwork)

plot_marker <- function(spe, marker) {
  umap_coords <- reducedDim(spe, "UMAP_harmony")
  expr <- assay(spe, "counts")[marker, ]
  
  df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2],
    expr  = expr
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = expr)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
    labs(title = marker, color = marker) +
    theme_bw()
}

# Mutually exclusive pairs
(plot_marker(spe_combined, "EpCAM") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "CD68")) /
  (plot_marker(spe_combined, "SMA") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "CD19"))

# Co-localizing markers
(plot_marker(spe_combined, "PD1") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "TIM3") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "LAG3"))

# Myeloid markers
(plot_marker(spe_combined, "CD68") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "CD163") | plot_marker(spe_combined, "CD14"))
```

Mutually exclusive markers are in separate UMAP regions.
